limitations: Headless packet tests do not render or automate the Bedrock inventory UI.
Retail inventory drag restrictions and held-item appearance require a retail client test.
Retail left-hand motion and inventory-transition flicker have not been visually verified.

Packet tests used the same Java changes before the final animation perspective gate changed from attachable context to vanilla player variables. Final animation expressions were separately checked in Blockbench.
